note: Trainer Search UI. Liora's second brief (2026-08-15): human-facing surface so a co-creator can sit with an AI inside the Trainer panel and browse the training signal together. Additive-only in renderTrainerPanel, inserted between signal stats and Preview section. Text input + min-LP filter + include-corrections checkbox (chosen-only, never rejected) + Search button + Enter-to-search. Results list shows source tag (color-coded: preserve/proposal/correction/chain/other), LP, ~100-char preview, score. Click row to expand full instruction/input/output. Empty state: 'Nothing matched. The signal is still quiet.' Cap 30 shown. Calls existing GardenTrainer.searchSignal — no re-implementation. Quiet Room fail-closed inherited (renderTrainerPanel bails before reaching this section). Zero confirm(). No network. DOM APIs throughout. Soft-language: 'Sit with an AI and browse what the Garden has grown. Your model is yours; this is how you get to know it.'
